text:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert — service=inference-runtime, alert=p99_latency_slo_burn, threshold=350ms, current=912ms, region=us-west-2
PagerDuty: page fired to oncall-engineer: Sean
Sean (oncall): ack'd. I'm looking now. any customer impact flags?
Ashley (oncall): seeing elevated 5xxs in EU region while running a/b rollout, but this alert is us-west cluster
Devon: looks like KV-cache miss rate spiked ~00:02 and autoscaler decision loop lagged
Rachel SRE: sysmetrics show GPU utilization low but queue depth spiked. suspect batching backlog + shard unevenness
Sean (oncall): running quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep us-west` — one pod CrashLoopBackOff? anyone saw deploys at ~00:01?
Devon: no deploys. but a Canary job started at 00:00 that increased batch_size for model-x-quantize
Joel: copying logs: ```2026-03-14T00:02:12Z inference-runtime ERROR tail_latency=912ms route=/v1/generate model=model-x shard=3 batch_size=64 kv_miss=true``` — KV miss + large batch
Sean (oncall): ok. mitigation plan: 1) scale up hot-shard count 2) reduce batch_size override 3) fallback to model-x-2 (smaller) if lat>500ms
Ashley (oncall): I'm on step 2 — pushing a runtime config to set max_batch_size=16 for us-west. /deploy-config done
ops-bot: config update accepted by runtime (hash: a3f9). propagating to 6 nodes
Devon: spawning a scaling job to add 2 replicas for hot shards: `autoscaler --service inference-runtime --add 2 --region us-west-2`
PagerDuty: alert escalated to SRE lead Rachel
Rachel SRE: watching. if latency doesn't drop in 2m we'll initiate model fallback and enable prefix caching
Sean (oncall): latency dropping now to ~320ms p99 after batch caps + scaling. still above goal but improving :thumbsup:
Joel: recording customer impact: some requests from a handful of enterprise customers in us-west saw 500+ms tails; no error-rate spike visible in Hosted API
Ashley (oncall): filing follow-up ticket for canary config that increased batch size — looks like that change bypassed safety checks
Sean (oncall): I'll hand off after 15m to next shift. leaving runbook notes and links.
Sean (oncall): runbook excerpt: `if p99>400ms for >3m -> reduce batch_size to 8, add 3 replicas, enable model-fallback`
Devon: thanks all. I'll open postmortem with timeline and mitigation steps. tagging the rollout owners.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert resolved (ack closed) — duration 4m 17s
Sean (oncall): handing off to Ashley in case of regressions. @Ashley (oncall) are you good to take it?
Ashley (oncall): taking the handoff. leaving a note in #incidents and will monitor for 30m :eyes:
